public_rationale: The testable core is that Sora's monkey-chess video shows realistic chessboard textures on a board that breaks chess conventions. The only sources describing the board are Marcus or outlets repeating him, and I could not inspect the video. The 'wrong generalization' framing goes further: it interprets how the model works and cannot be checked directly. With no independent account of the video, the claim stays unresolved.
limitations: The interpretive framing cannot be fully verified even with the video.
Direct viewing of the video was not possible.
